name: West Bank and Gaza
headline: West Bank and Gaza: +4.3% growth in 2025, 9.8% inflation
sections: West Bank and Gaza is a $17.2 billion economy (2025), the world's 142nd-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +4.3% in 2025, faster than the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $5,000 at purchasing-power parity (2025), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 11.3% of GDP (2024).
Consumer prices rose 9.8% in 2025, above typical targets, up from 3.7% in 2022. Unemployment stood at 24.4% (2022), above the world median of 5.1%. Youth unemployment was 36.1% (2022).
No recent data is available for this section.
The current account balance is −15.8% of GDP (2025), a sizeable external financing need. Trade equals 75% of GDP (2025), a fairly open economy. Net FDI inflows were 1.9% of GDP (2025).
Life expectancy is 69.2 years (2024). Population: 5.4 million (2025).
note: Built from official World Bank and IMF data; IMF projections are labelled as projections.
